description: Controller-owned actual B capture request, not caller provenance assertions.

input.description: Exact actual private inputs, including context boundaries/final labels.

limits.description: Actual positive logical admission; not total memory qualification.

profile.description: Explicit actually executed objective and numerical graph profile.

source.description: Actual complete stored-byte B source, not widened-f32 identity.

tensors.description: Actual ordered projection interpretations, followed by tied head.

tokenizer_config.description: Exact admitted tokenizer_config.json bytes for text; absent for token IDs.

transform.description: Actual mandatory A->B transform log reference.

BlobId.description: Content identity for stored tensor or asset bytes.

CalibrationCacheLimits.description: Logical retained cache bounds, separate from reducer workspace or process RSS.

max_payload_bytes.description: Exact retained scalar/token/mask and recipe bytes; excludes metadata/capacity overhead.

max_samples.description: Maximum observed samples, including masked samples.

max_windows.description: Maximum declared model-context windows, not reduction replay chunks.

CalibrationCaptureInput.description: Exact ordered private calibration inputs, not an asserted input digest.

oneOf.description: Pretokenized windows, each including its final target.
Actual runtime encoding: raw text, no special tokens/padding/truncation.

windows.description: Exact UTF-8 windows; private evidence may contain private corpus text.

CalibrationCaptureLimits.description: Logical model/input/cache bounds, NOT tape/parser/package/evidence/full RSS.

max_config_bytes.description: Actual config input-byte cap before model parsing.

max_dense_bytes.description: Retained widened-f32 master matrix/vector cap before decoding.

max_text_bytes.description: Aggregate raw UTF-8 text bytes; zero for pretokenized capture.

max_tokenizer_config_bytes.description: tokenizer_config.json bytes; zero for pretokenized capture.

max_total_payload_bytes.description: Aggregate retained payload, including duplicated context bytes.

max_window_tokens.description: Effective maximum input tokens per context (excluding final label).

CalibrationCaptureProfile.description: The fixed actually executed objective and widened-f32 graph profile.

oneOf.description: Per-window mean next-token CE, sparse k1 labels, unit weights/true masks.

EvidenceReference.description: Evidence ancestry reference, not a self-approved quality/release verdict.

root.description: BLAKE3 evidence root, not a blob id or package digest.

run.description: Run identity of the evidence producer.

OriginalSourceId.description: Candidate identity of original named tensor/asset content, not fitted content or provenance.

PackageId.description: Content identity for a Tritium package.

QuantSourceTensor.description: Original tensor interpretation, never an adapter-supplied content hash.

precision.description: Original stored float precision, before widening or fitting.

shape.description: Positive row-major dimensions in the original source.

ScalePrecision.description: Precision used to store additive plane scales.
